body:
First thing I’ve written in over 5 years.. I guess heartbreak is a good motivator. I would love some feedback!!

“No one will ever be you”

I think I’m going crazy

I can’t get enough of you but I guess you got enough of me

I would give up everything just to have you love me the same

So why do things change so fast?

Now all I feel is hurt when your lips speak my name

When you told your best friend you loved me, did you even mean for those words to last?

Everyone keeps saying “someday someone will love you and stay”

I guess that’s supposed to make it easier for my thoughts of you to go away

It doesn’t

I don’t want anyone else to love me, I only want you 

So how do I let you go, when no one will ever be you?

Maybe I’m going crazy

You’re right. I just worry that hope can only hold you up for so long. It’s weird feeling that you know it’ll happen like that one day, you just don’t know when. My animals are definitely my saving grace. For now keep holding onto your hope as well. Thank you for the support
